profile.headline: Software Development Professional
profile.summary:
Software Professional with experience in cloud infrastructure and a variety of domains, including: mobile devices, AR, speech, e-commerce, mortgage/real estate & financial services, sales performance management, supply chain management, manufacturing, telecom.

Proponent of lightweight, loosely coupled, scalable and testable architectures.
